$Classic Controller
*By quatric
*New Play Control! Pikmin 2 (Europe/Australia) (R92P01)
*Play with a Classic Controller plugged into the Wii Remote: left stick moves, right stick aims the cursor.
*A throw, B whistle, X dismiss, Y/- switch leader, ZL camera, L/R sprays, ZR swarm, D-pad camera.
* KPAD sampling callback: Classic Controller sample -> Wii Remote + Nunchuk sample

$GameCube controller
*By quatric
*New Play Control! Pikmin 2 (Europe/Australia) (R92P01)
*Play with a GameCube controller in port 1 (no Wii Remote needed), using the
*original GameCube game's controls: stick moves and aims, C stick swarms, X dismiss, Y switch leader.
* KPAD sampling callback: GameCube pad -> Wii Remote + Nunchuk sample
